coordinateConvention: crop is integer [x,y,width,height] on the referenced bundled 640×640 source. It includes 6px photographed fabric margin for blending where safe, no white gallery background. Placement objects are normalized to the explicitly recorded torso rectangle; origin upper-left, y increases downward. texturePlacement maps the full crop, printPlacement maps the visible print union. These are visually estimated placement guides, not sewing specifications.
